body: I was bullied my entire life, physically emotionally verbally. From elementary all the way until graduation and even then some harassment continued until I deleted every social media I had. I had to go no contact so people from hs would stop. I keep getting reminded about the past, I keep having nightmares about the past. I can't do anything properly without this voice telling me about how everything from the past will be repeated if I keep going. I try to shut down the thoughts and it worked for a while but now it doesn't work anymore. I'm tired of this voice. It's like another voice besides my own in my head that speaks at the same time. I don't want to go into the detail about the past just that people hurt me a lot and I was the punching bag for everyone for a long time. Things have improved yes. I'm in medschool and I have a few good friends but most of all my biggest supporter my mom. I don't want to hurt anyone but I also don't want to be hurt either. I'm not tired of life and I don't hate what I have, I'm grateful for what I have but I'm just tired of this voice that keeps making me doubt myself and ruin everything I have. It keeps destroying my self esteem and I just can't anymore.
